title: Firm turnover under asymmetric information: Tanzania's agro‐dealer sector
title_zh: 信息不对称下的企业更替：坦桑尼亚农资经销商部门
title_primary: 信息不对称下的企业更替：坦桑尼亚农资经销商部门
title_secondary: Firm turnover under asymmetric information: Tanzania's agro‐dealer sector
authors: Alix Naugler, Hope Michelson, Sarah Janzen, Christopher Magomba
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-09-11 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We study firm turnover (i.e., entry and exit) and its consumer implications in a market characterized by asymmetric information. Using a three‐round census of agro‐dealers in Tanzania's Morogoro Region, we document annual firm entry and exit rates of 33% and 17%, respectively. These rates are more than double those observed for non‐agricultural micro‐, small‐, and medium‐enterprises in comparable low‐income countries. To analyze how these high rates of entry and exit affect consumers, we develop a theoretical model of firm turnover under asymmetric information and empirically test its predictions for farmers. We find that farmers' market‐level beliefs about agricultural input quality are systematically related to agro‐dealer turnover, with the relationship depending on farmers' prior perceptions of market quality. Farmers report more favorable beliefs about agricultural input quality in markets with recent agro‐dealer exits, consistent with our model when consumers perceive exiting firms as having sold low‐quality products. In contrast, farmers who usually purchased agricultural inputs from the same agro‐dealer expect new market entrants to provide lower‐quality agricultural inputs, suggesting farmers rely on incumbent relationships to manage quality uncertainty in markets with information asymmetries. As a result, agro‐dealer turnover may shape and even attenuate farmers' technology adoption.

title: Changes in the Fertility of Highly Skilled Women: Accounting for Heterogeneity in Preferences for Children
title_zh: 高技能女性生育率的变化：考虑子女生育偏好的异质性
title_primary: 高技能女性生育率的变化：考虑子女生育偏好的异质性
title_secondary: Changes in the Fertility of Highly Skilled Women: Accounting for Heterogeneity in Preferences for Children
authors: DongIk Kang, Youngjae Lee
official: 官方在线 2026-09-06 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Over the past four decades, the negative relationship between income and fertility in the United States has flattened. We document two additional patterns: fertility variation within income groups has increased, and the average preference for children among high income women has risen. We propose a novel channel through which heterogeneity in fertility preferences interacts with changes in the wage and price structures to reshape the income–fertility relationship as documented. To assess its quantitative importance, we develop an overlapping generations model with heterogeneity in productivity and fertility preferences, alongside existing mechanisms from the literature. The model reproduces the joint evolution of fertility rates, fertility variation, and fertility preferences, and shows that the proposed mechanism is important for changes in fertility behavior across the income distribution.
abstract_zh: 过去四十年间，美国收入与生育率之间的负相关关系已趋于平缓。我们记录了两个额外现象：收入群体内部的生育率差异有所增加，以及高收入女性对子女的平均偏好上升。我们提出一个新渠道，通过该渠道，生育偏好的异质性与工资及价格结构的变化相互作用，重塑了所记录的“收入-生育”关系。为评估其量化重要性，我们构建了一个包含生产率和生育偏好异质性，并融合文献中现有机制的世代交叠模型。该模型再现了生育率、生育率差异及生育偏好的联合演变，并表明所提出的机制对于收入分布上生育行为的变化具有重要意义。

title: Mortality regressivity and pension design
title_zh: 死亡率累退性与养老金设计
title_primary: 死亡率累退性与养老金设计
title_secondary: Mortality regressivity and pension design
authors: Youngsoo Jang, Svetlana Pashchenko, Ponpoje Porapakkarm
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-28 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Should public policies address inequality due to heterogeneous life expectancy? Intuitively, taking a short life as a disadvantage, such policies should favor those with high mortality. Yet, pension systems implicitly redistribute from low-life-expectancy to high-life-expectancy people. Moreover, this direction of redistribution is optimal from the perspective of the standard utilitarian welfare criterion. We study mortality-related redistribution in a more flexible setting. We start by establishing a formal framework for the analysis by clearly distinguishing between redistribution along the mortality and income dimensions. We then characterize the conditions under which it is optimal to redistribute toward high-mortality people. One such condition is that the welfare criterion must feature an aversion to lifetime inequality that exceeds the aversion to consumption inequality.
abstract_zh: 公共政策是否应解决因预期寿命异质性导致的不平等问题？直觉上，将短命视为一种劣势，此类政策应倾向于高死亡率群体。然而，养老金体系却隐性地将资源从低预期寿命者向高预期寿命者再分配。此外，从标准功利主义福利准则的角度看，这种再分配方向是最优的。我们在一个更灵活的框架下研究死亡率相关的再分配问题。首先，通过明确区分沿死亡率维度和收入维度的再分配，建立正式的分析框架。随后，我们刻画了向高死亡率群体再分配为最优的条件。其中一个条件是，福利准则必须体现出对终身不平等的厌恶程度超过对消费不平等的厌恶程度。

title: Beyond the Black Box: Unraveling the Role of Explainability in Human-Artificial Intelligence Collaboration
title_zh: 超越黑箱：解析可解释性在人机协作中的作用
title_primary: 超越黑箱：解析可解释性在人机协作中的作用
title_secondary: Beyond the Black Box: Unraveling the Role of Explainability in Human-Artificial Intelligence Collaboration
authors: Tamer Boyacı, Caner Canyakmaz, Francis de Véricourt
official: 官方在线 2026-08-19 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Explainable artificial intelligence (AI) models have been proposed to mitigate overreliance and underreliance on AI, which reduce the effectiveness of human-AI collaborative tools. Yet, empirical evidence is mixed, and the impact of explainable AI on the cognitive effort and fatigue of a decision maker (DM) is often overlooked. This paper offers a theoretical perspective on these issues. We develop an analytical model that incorporates the defining features of human and machine intelligence, capturing the limited but flexible nature of human cognition with imperfect machine recommendations. Crucially, we represent how AI-based explanations influence the DM’s belief in the algorithm’s predictive quality. Our results indicate that explainable AI has varying effects depending on the level of explainability provided. Although low explainability levels have no impact on decision accuracy and reliance behavior, they lessen the cognitive burden on the DM. In contrast, higher explainability levels enhance accuracy by improving overreliance but at the expense of increased underreliance. Further, the relative impact of explainability is higher when the DM is more cognitively constrained, when the decision task is sufficiently complex, or when the stakes are lower. Importantly, higher explainability levels can escalate the DM’s cognitive burden (and hence, overall processing time and fatigue) precisely when explanations are most needed (i.e., when the DM is pressed for time to complete a complex task and doubts the machine’s quality). Our study clarifies how explainability affects decision outcomes and cognitive effort, informing the design of effective human-AI systems across decision environments. This paper was accepted by Jeannette Song, operations management. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.07450 .
abstract_zh: 可解释人工智能（AI）模型已被提出，以缓解对AI的过度依赖和依赖不足问题，这些问题削弱了人机协作工具的有效性。然而，实证证据不一，且可解释AI对决策者认知努力和疲劳的影响常被忽视。本文从理论视角探讨这些问题。我们构建了一个分析模型，融合了人类智能与机器智能的定义性特征，捕捉了人类认知的有限但灵活特性，并结合了不完美的机器建议。关键的是，我们刻画了基于AI的解释如何影响决策者对算法预测质量的信念。我们的结果表明，可解释AI的效果因提供的可解释性水平而异。尽管低可解释性水平对决策准确性和依赖行为无影响，但它们减轻了决策者的认知负担。相反，较高的可解释性水平通过改善过度依赖来提升准确性，但代价是增加了依赖不足。此外，当决策者认知受限更严重、决策任务足够复杂或风险较低时，可解释性的相对影响更大。重要的是，较高的可解释性水平恰恰在解释最被需要时（即决策者时间紧迫需完成复杂任务且怀疑机器质量时）可能加剧决策者的认知负担（从而增加整体处理时间和疲劳）。我们的研究阐明了可解释性如何影响决策结果和认知努力，为在不同决策环境中设计有效的人机系统提供了指导。本文被运营管理领域的Jeannette Song接受。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.07450获取。

title: The heterogeneous impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on income: evidence from Russia
title_zh: COVID-19疫情对收入的不均衡影响：来自俄罗斯的证据
title_primary: COVID-19疫情对收入的不均衡影响：来自俄罗斯的证据
title_secondary: The heterogeneous impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on income: evidence from Russia
authors: Elena Kotyrlo, Wenrui Zhang
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-04 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: The study investigates the heterogeneity of the effect of COVID-19 pandemic-related restrictions on economic well-being in Russia based on labour market size, socio-demographic groups and income distribution. We examine the effect by composing a group of private-sector workers affected by pandemic-related restrictions in the labour market. We use public-sector workers as a counterfactual. Difference‑in‑differences, as the main approach, is combined with propensity score matching and applied to evaluate the average and quantile treatment effects. The results based on microdata from the RLMS-HSE reveal that the restrictions led to a loss of individual income of approximately 13%. However, the income decline was lower at the household level. In contrast to other crises, the pandemic led to significant income losses among working-age individuals, male workers and workers with secondary education. We note a negative effect on income in the top quantiles of the income distribution for the entire sample and in the median and lower quantiles for single-parent households and households with members who have severe health problems. The article contributes to the literature by identifying the heterogeneous effects of the pandemic restrictions in Russia and ruling out confounding factors. KEYWORDS: COVID-19 difference-in-differences quantile difference-in-differences equivalised income public–private sectoral gap JEL CLASSIFICATION: C21 D31 E24 Acknowledgements We express our gratitude to the two anonymous reviewers for their constructive comments.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了新冠疫情相关限制措施对俄罗斯经济福祉影响的异质性，基于劳动力市场规模、社会人口群体及收入分配维度进行分析。我们通过构建受疫情相关劳动力市场限制影响的私营部门工作者群体来考察该效应，并以公共部门工作者作为反事实参照。采用双重差分法作为主要分析方法，结合倾向得分匹配，评估平均处理效应与分位数处理效应。基于RLMS-HSE微观数据的实证结果显示，限制措施导致个人收入损失约13%，但家庭层面的收入下降幅度较小。与其他危机不同，疫情导致劳动年龄个体、男性工作者及中等教育水平工作者的收入显著损失。我们注意到，在全样本收入分布的高分位数处存在负向收入效应，而在单亲家庭及有严重健康问题成员的家庭中，中位数及低分位数处也呈现负向影响。本文通过识别俄罗斯疫情限制措施的异质性效应并排除混杂因素，为现有文献作出贡献。关键词：COVID-19；双重差分法；分位数双重差分法；等值收入；公共-私营部门差距 JEL分类：C21 D31 E24 致谢：我们感谢两位匿名审稿人的建设性意见。

Our experiment randomly assigns air purifiers to rooms at three large academic conferences to investigate the causal impact of air pollution on participants

title: Can Equity Enhance Efficiency? Some Lessons from Climate Negotiations
title_zh: 公平能否提升效率？气候谈判中的若干启示
title_primary: 公平能否提升效率？气候谈判中的若干启示
title_secondary: Can Equity Enhance Efficiency? Some Lessons from Climate Negotiations
authors: Carlo Carraro, Francesco Bosello, Barbara Buchner, Davide Raggi, Daniel Gallardo Albarrán 等
official: 官方在线 2003-02-20 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This Paper analyses the relationship between different equity rules and the incentives to sign and ratify a climate agreement. A widespread conjecture suggests that a more equitable distribution of the burden of reducing emissions would enhance the incentives for more countries ? particularly big emitters ? to accept an emission reduction scheme defined within an international climate agreement. This Paper shows that this conjecture is only partly supported by the empirical evidence that can be derived from the recent outcomes of climate negotiations. Even though an equitable sharing of the costs of controlling GHG emissions can provide better incentives to sign and ratify a climate agreement than the burden sharing implicit in the Kyoto agreement, a stable global agreement cannot be achieved. A possible strategy to achieve a global agreement without free-riding incentives is a policy mix in which global emission trading is coupled with a transfer mechanism designed to offset incentives to free ride.
abstract_zh: 本文分析了不同公平规则与签署及批准气候协议激励之间的关系。一种普遍观点认为，更公平地分配减排负担将增强更多国家（尤其是排放大国）接受国际气候协议中减排方案的激励。本文表明，这一观点仅部分得到近期气候谈判结果中可推导出的经验证据支持。尽管公平分担温室气体排放控制成本比《京都议定书》隐含的负担分担更能提供签署和批准气候协议的激励，但稳定的全球协议仍无法实现。实现无搭便车激励的全球协议的可能策略是政策组合：将全球排放交易与旨在抵消搭便车激励的转移机制相结合。

title: Climate Change, Demand Uncertainty, and Firms' Investments: Evidence from Planned Power Plants
title_zh: 气候变化、需求不确定性与企业投资：来自计划发电厂的证据
title_primary: 气候变化、需求不确定性与企业投资：来自计划发电厂的证据
title_secondary: Climate Change, Demand Uncertainty, and Firms' Investments: Evidence from Planned Power Plants
authors: CHEN LIN, THOMAS SCHMID, MICHAEL S. WEISBACH
official: 官方在线 2026-07-23 · 来源：RSS
abstract: How does demand uncertainty affect firms' investment decisions? We examine this question in the context of electricity‐producing firms' planned investments in new power plants. We measure uncertainty about future electricity demand using plausibly exogenous variation in temperature projections across scientific climate models. The results show that uncertainty increases investment in power plants with flexible production technologies, while reducing investment in less flexible technologies. Overall, the net effect of uncertainty on investment is positive when firms have access to flexible investment opportunities. These findings are consistent with models in which production flexibility shapes the investment response to demand uncertainty.
abstract_zh: 需求不确定性如何影响企业的投资决策？我们以电力生产企业对新电厂的投资计划为背景研究这一问题。利用不同科学气候模型对温度预测的外生差异，我们衡量了未来电力需求的不确定性。结果表明，不确定性增加了对采用灵活生产技术电厂的投资，同时减少了对灵活性较低技术的投资。总体而言，当企业拥有灵活的投资机会时，不确定性对投资的净效应为正。这些发现与生产灵活性决定投资对需求不确定性反应的模型一致。

title: Less is more: Institutional investors and corporate venture capital
title_zh: 少即是多：机构投资者与企业风险投资
title_primary: 少即是多：机构投资者与企业风险投资
title_secondary: Less is more: Institutional investors and corporate venture capital
authors: Dongxu Li, Yifei Mao, Xuan Tian, Kailei Ye
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-20 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This study examines how passive institutional investors reshape corporate venture capital (CVC) investment decisions. We find that increases in passive institutional ownership lead firms to cut back CVC investments in non-core, high-risk, and low-quality ventures, with the reduction being more pronounced among firms subject to more severe managerial agency problems. Futhermore, the reduction of CVC investments leads to higher short-term announcement returns and improved long-term operating and innovation performance. The findings suggest that passive institutional investors mitigate managerial agency problems and improve innovation by disciplining CVC investment decisions.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了被动机构投资者如何重塑企业风险投资（CVC）决策。我们发现，被动机构持股比例的增加促使企业削减对非核心、高风险及低质量项目的CVC投资，且这一削减效应在面临更严重管理层代理问题的企业中更为显著。此外，CVC投资的减少带来了更高的短期公告回报，并改善了长期运营与创新绩效。研究结果表明，被动机构投资者通过约束CVC投资决策，缓解了管理层代理问题并促进了创新。

title: On the Origins of Modern East Asia: Knowledge and the Economic Transformation of Japan and China in the late 19th century
title_zh: 论近代东亚的起源：19世纪末日本与中国的知识及经济转型
title_primary: 论近代东亚的起源：19世纪末日本与中国的知识及经济转型
title_secondary: On the Origins of Modern East Asia: Knowledge and the Economic Transformation of Japan and China in the late 19th century
authors: Ma, Debin, Rubin, Jared, Weiwen, Yin
official: 官方在线 2026-07-20 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper revisits the old thesis of the contrasting paths of modernization between Japan and China. It develops a new analytical framework regarding the role of knowledge acquisition (propositional vs. prescriptive) and political centralization as the key drivers behind these contrasting paths. Our model and historical data highlight how the introduction of these elements contributed to Meiji Japan's decisive turn towards the West and Qing China's lethargic response to Western imperialism. Our analytical framework, developed from a comparative historical narrative and quantitative data, sheds new insights onto the importance of knowledge acquisition for enabling developing countries to reach the world's economic frontier.
abstract_zh: 本文重新审视了日本与中国现代化路径对比的经典命题，构建了一个新的分析框架，聚焦于知识获取（命题性知识与规范性知识）和政治集权作为这些对比路径背后的关键驱动力。我们的模型与历史数据凸显了这些要素的引入如何促成明治日本果断转向西方，以及清朝中国对西方帝国主义反应迟缓。基于比较历史叙事与定量数据所发展的分析框架，为知识获取在助力发展中国家迈向世界经济前沿中的重要性提供了新的洞见。

title: Inference with AI-Generated Covariates
title_zh: 使用AI生成协变量的推断
title_primary: 使用AI生成协变量的推断
title_secondary: Inference with AI-Generated Covariates
authors: Junting Duan, Markus Pelger
official: 官方在线 2026-07-20 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Empirical researchers increasingly use large language models (LLMs) to extract structured features, such as sentiment scores, classifications, and expectations, from unstructured data and treat these generated features as observed covariates in downstream estimation. This practice can invalidate inference when systematic, input-dependent errors in generated features, such as hallucination and look-ahead bias, distort the downstream moment conditions. Even after correction, generated features remain noisy proxies whose error profiles differ across models and prompts. We introduce AI-Powered Inference (AI-PI), a method-of-moments framework for valid and efficient inference that combines three components: a moment-specific bias correction based on a small human-labeled calibration set; adaptive weights that optimally combine multiple model-prompt pairs; and an optimal calibration-set design that concentrates costly human labels where the generated features are least reliable. We establish consistency and asymptotic normality of the AI-PI estimator, allowing for data-adaptive labeling designs, cross-fitted LLM-pipeline tuning, and overidentified GMM. Simulations confirm substantial gains over naive LLM regressions and over debiasing without optimal weighting or labeling design. In an application to news-based sentiment and stock returns, AI-PI produces stable conclusions where naive analyses vary substantially across LLM and prompt choices, with a confidence interval roughly half as long as using the human-labeled data alone.
abstract_zh: 实证研究者越来越多地使用大型语言模型（LLMs）从非结构化数据中提取结构化特征（如情感得分、分类和预期），并将这些生成的特征作为下游估计中的观测协变量。当生成特征中存在系统性、依赖于输入的误差（如幻觉和前瞻性偏差）扭曲下游矩条件时，这种做法可能导致推断失效。即使经过修正，生成特征仍是带有噪声的代理变量，其误差特征因模型和提示词的不同而存在差异。我们提出AI驱动推断（AI-PI），这是一种基于矩方法的框架，用于实现有效且高效的推断，它结合了三个组成部分：基于少量人工标注校准集的矩特定偏差修正；能够最优组合多个模型-提示词对的自适应权重；以及将昂贵的人工标注集中于生成特征最不可靠区域的最优校准集设计。我们建立了AI-PI估计量的一致性和渐近正态性，允许数据自适应标注设计、交叉拟合的LLM流水线调优以及过度识别的广义矩估计（GMM）。模拟结果证实，与朴素LLM回归以及未采用最优权重或标注设计的去偏方法相比，该方法具有显著优势。在基于新闻的情感与股票收益的应用中，AI-PI得出了稳定的结论，而朴素分析在不同LLM和提示词选择下结果差异显著，其置信区间长度约为仅使用人工标注数据时的一半。

title: What Drives Crypto Mining? Evidence from Hardware Imports
title_zh: 什么驱动了加密货币挖矿？来自硬件进口的证据
title_primary: 什么驱动了加密货币挖矿？来自硬件进口的证据
title_secondary: What Drives Crypto Mining? Evidence from Hardware Imports
authors: Andras Komaromi & Federico Grinberg & Mr. Diego A. Cerdeiro & Yang Liu
official: 官方在线 2026-07-10 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Understanding financial activity beyond traditional regulatory frameworks is essential for policymakers. Yet cryptocurrency mining—which offers a direct entry point into the crypto ecosystem without relying on traditional financial intermediaries—remains highly opaque. We propose a novel measurement approach using detailed customs data that tracks exports of crypto mining hardware from the world’s dominant producers. This trade-based proxy allows us to analyze the global distribution of mining hardware imports and identify their key drivers, guided by a stylized model. Empirically, mining surges respond strongly to global factors such as cryptocurrency prices and hardware costs, while domestic factors—including electricity prices and ambient temperature—shape the cross-country distribution of activity. Our findings highlight how global crypto markets, natural endowments, and policy choices jointly influence mining incentives, offering valuable insights for policymakers concerned with financial stability risks and energy subsidy misuse.
abstract_zh: 理解传统监管框架之外的金融活动对政策制定者至关重要。然而，加密货币挖矿——作为无需依赖传统金融中介即可直接进入加密生态系统的途径——仍然高度不透明。我们提出了一种新颖的测量方法，利用详细的关税数据追踪全球主要生产商出口的加密挖矿硬件。这一基于贸易的代理变量使我们能够分析挖矿硬件进口的全球分布，并借助一个简化模型识别其关键驱动因素。实证结果显示，挖矿活动激增对加密货币价格和硬件成本等全球因素反应强烈，而国内因素——包括电价和环境温度——则塑造了活动的跨国分布。我们的发现揭示了全球加密市场、自然禀赋和政策选择如何共同影响挖矿激励，为关注金融稳定风险和能源补贴滥用的政策制定者提供了宝贵见解。

title: Trade Circumvention in China's Anti‐Dumping Measures Against the U.S.
title_zh: 中国对美反倾销措施中的贸易规避问题
title_primary: 中国对美反倾销措施中的贸易规避问题
title_secondary: Trade Circumvention in China's Anti‐Dumping Measures Against the U.S.
authors: Huimin Shi, Kaili Zhang, Li Jiang
official: 官方在线 2026-07-07 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper investigates whether and how U.S. exporters circumvent China's anti‐dumping (AD) measures by re‐routing trade through third countries. Using detailed data on AD cases and monthly trade flows of China and U.S. from 2002 to 2011, we apply a triple‐differences (DDD) approach to identify abnormal trade‐flow adjustments consistent with third‐country re‐routing. We find evidence of such patterns in a subset of cases following final AD rulings. Product characteristics, such as lower differentiation, higher financial leverage, and greater inventory pressure, are associated with variation in the feasibility and intensity of circumvention. Moreover, circumvention tends to occur through countries that are institutionally closer to the U.S. and geographically concentrated in Asia‐Oceania routes. The possible circumvention emerges after final rulings rather than during investigations.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了美国出口商是否以及如何通过第三国转运来规避中国的反倾销措施。基于2002年至2011年间中国与美国的反倾销案例详细数据及月度贸易流量，我们采用三重差分法识别与第三国转运模式相符的异常贸易流量调整。研究发现，在最终反倾销裁决后的部分案例中存在此类模式。产品特征（如差异化程度较低、财务杠杆较高及库存压力较大）与规避行为的可行性和强度差异相关。此外，规避行为往往通过与美国制度距离较近且地理上集中于亚洲-大洋洲路线的国家发生。可能的规避行为出现在最终裁决之后，而非调查期间。

title: Special Issue: Climate Change and Inequality
title_zh: 特刊：气候变化与不平等
title_primary: 特刊：气候变化与不平等
title_secondary: Special Issue: Climate Change and Inequality
authors: Alberto Bisin
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-07 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This Special Issue of The Economic Journal brings together papers at the frontier of dynamic, spatial and heterogeneous-agent structural modelling for the study of climate change and climate policy. These models are designed to be consistent with the fundamentals of climate science and to be calibrated and/or taken to the data. In this respect, Eftekhari, Folini, Friedl, Kubler, Scheidegger and Schenk contribute a methodological paper to the Issue, developing efficient climate emulators that can be embedded within economic models of climate change. Centring on the link between climate change and inequality, the papers in the Issue span different, and often complementary, dimensions of heterogeneity in the effects of climate change and various mitigation policies, most notably carbon taxes. Taken together, they show that the distributional consequences of climate action depend crucially on where a policy is implemented, how markets transmit shocks across regions and countries, and which households or regions are most exposed through income, wealth, consumption baskets, production structures or demographic characteristics.
abstract_zh: 《经济学期刊》本期特刊汇集了运用动态、空间及异质性主体结构模型研究气候变化与气候政策的前沿论文。这些模型旨在与气候科学基本原理保持一致，并经过校准和/或实证数据验证。基于此，Eftekhari、Folini、Friedl、Kubler、Scheidegger与Schenk为本期特刊贡献了一篇方法论论文，开发了可嵌入气候变化经济模型的高效气候模拟器。围绕气候变化与不平等之间的关联，本期论文涵盖了气候变化及各类减缓政策（尤其是碳税）影响中不同且常具互补性的异质性维度。综合来看，这些研究表明：气候行动分配效应的关键取决于政策实施地点、市场如何跨区域和国家传导冲击，以及哪些家庭或地区通过收入、财富、消费篮子、生产结构或人口特征面临最大风险。

title: Human capital consequences of expanding the supply of higher education institutions in a developing country
title_zh: 发展中国家扩大高等教育机构供给的人力资本后果
title_primary: 发展中国家扩大高等教育机构供给的人力资本后果
title_secondary: Human capital consequences of expanding the supply of higher education institutions in a developing country
authors: Noemí Katzkowicz, Victor Lavy, Martina Querejeta, Tatiana Rosá
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-06 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Limited post-secondary education infrastructure and opportunities partly explain low higher education attainment in developing countries. This paper estimates the effect of a program that expanded higher education by constructing numerous university campuses across Uruguay. Exploiting temporal and geographic variation in the program’s rollout, we use a dynamic two-way fixed-effects design and comprehensive administrative records to estimate the program’s causal impact. By reducing the distance to the nearest campus, the program increased university enrollment by 34 percent relative to baseline, with especially large gains among less-privileged, first-generation students. Spillovers extend up to 30 kilometers from new campuses, with effects concentrated among students from less-educated families, thereby reducing spatial inequality. We also find that university expansion increased secondary-school enrollment and completion, a relevant result given that low secondary school completion rates remain one of the main barriers to higher education. These improvements occurred without lowering tertiary completion rates. A cost-effectiveness analysis reveals substantial private and social returns, with costs comparable to those of a scholarship program, while reducing spatial inequalities. Overall, the findings suggest that place-based expansion of higher education can reduce spatial inequalities and foster intergenerational mobility in developing countries cost-effectively.
abstract_zh: 有限的后中等教育基础设施和机会部分解释了发展中国家高等教育入学率低下的原因。本文评估了一项通过在乌拉圭各地建设众多大学校园来扩大高等教育的项目所产生的效应。利用该项目推广过程中的时间和地理差异，我们采用动态双向固定效应设计及全面的行政记录来估计该项目的因果影响。通过缩短至最近校园的距离，该项目使大学入学率相对于基线提高了34%，其中在弱势家庭背景的首代大学生中收益尤为显著。溢出效应延伸至新校园周边30公里范围内，且影响集中于来自教育程度较低家庭的学生，从而缩小了空间不平等。我们还发现，大学扩张提高了中学入学率和完成率，鉴于中学完成率低下仍是高等教育的主要障碍之一，这一结果具有重要意义。这些改善并未以降低高等教育完成率为代价。成本效益分析揭示了可观的私人和社会回报，其成本与奖学金项目相当，同时减少了空间不平等。总体而言，研究结果表明，以地方为基础的高等教育扩张能够以成本有效的方式减少发展中国家的空间不平等并促进代际流动性。

title: Product heterogeneity, price index bias, and their link to provincial urban size: Evidence from urban China's beverage market
title_zh: 产品异质性、价格指数偏差及其与省级城市规模的关联：来自中国城市饮料市场的证据
title_primary: 产品异质性、价格指数偏差及其与省级城市规模的关联：来自中国城市饮料市场的证据
title_secondary: Product heterogeneity, price index bias, and their link to provincial urban size: Evidence from urban China's beverage market
authors: Soye Shin
official: 官方在线 2026-07-02 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Conventional price indexes partially address product heterogeneity. This paper considers the variety and quality of products in each market, the combination of region and year, and constructs panel price indexes using household scanner data on non‐alcoholic beverages in urban China. By comparing our panel price indexes to a conventional one, we find that ignoring product heterogeneity could largely underestimate the cross‐market price differences for non‐alcoholic beverages. We also find that product variety increases with urban population and income per capita, but that quality decreases with urban population, suggesting that wealthier provincial urban markets tend to have higher consumer welfare.
abstract_zh: 摘要 传统价格指数仅部分解决了产品异质性问题。本文考虑每个市场（即地区与年份的组合）中产品的品种与质量，利用中国城市非酒精饮料的家庭扫描数据构建了面板价格指数。通过将我们的面板价格指数与传统价格指数进行比较，我们发现忽略产品异质性可能会严重低估非酒精饮料的跨市场价格差异。研究还发现，产品品种随城市人口和人均收入增加而增加，但质量随城市人口增加而下降，这表明更富裕的省级城市市场往往具有更高的消费者福利。

title: How Climate Shocks Produce Armed Rebellion: The 1970 Bhola Cyclone and the Birth of Bangladesh
title_zh: 气候冲击如何引发武装叛乱：1970年波拉气旋与孟加拉国的诞生
title_primary: 气候冲击如何引发武装叛乱：1970年波拉气旋与孟加拉国的诞生
title_secondary: How Climate Shocks Produce Armed Rebellion: The 1970 Bhola Cyclone and the Birth of Bangladesh
authors: Sultan Mehmood, Ahmed Mushfiq Mobarak
official: 官方在线 2026-06-22 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Why do climate shocks produce conflict (Hsiang et al., 2013)? We study the 1970 Bhola cyclone in East Pakistan, one of the deadliest natural disasters in recorded history, which killed an estimated 350,000 people. Using satellite imagery, archival records, electoral returns, and insurgent biographies, we show that cyclone exposure amplified pre-existing separatist sentiment at the ballot box and increased citizens’ subsequent participation in guerrilla warfare against the state. Our estimates imply that exposure to the cyclone’s devastation induced an additional 48,613 insurgents to join the guerrilla war effort. Effects are larger in areas with pre-existing political and economic grievances and weaker relief provision. Our analysis reveals the step-by-step mechanisms through which environmental shocks can produce conflict: they shift voting behavior, expose state indifference, and convert grievance into armed mobilization.
abstract_zh: 气候冲击为何会引发冲突（Hsiang等，2013）？我们以1970年东巴基斯坦博拉气旋为研究对象，这是有记录以来最致命的自然灾害之一，造成约35万人死亡。通过卫星影像、档案记录、选举结果和叛乱分子传记资料，我们证明气旋暴露程度放大了选票箱中既有的分离主义情绪，并增加了公民随后参与针对国家的游击战行为。我们的估算表明，遭受气旋破坏的地区额外催生了48,613名叛乱分子加入游击战。在既有政治经济不满情绪更强烈且救济供给更薄弱的地区，影响更为显著。本分析揭示了环境冲击引发冲突的逐步传导机制：改变投票行为、暴露国家冷漠态度、将不满情绪转化为武装动员。

title: On the optimality of social security instruments
title_zh: 论社会保障工具的最优性
title_primary: 论社会保障工具的最优性
title_secondary: On the optimality of social security instruments
authors: Pablo Garcia‐Sanchez, Luca Marchiori, Olivier Pierrard
official: 官方在线 2026-06-05 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Public pension and public health care policies – collectively referred to here as social security policies – are costly and increasingly challenged by demographic shifts. Using a two‐period overlapping generations model in which health investment affects both mortality and morbidity, we analytically study the optimal design of social security. Our model incorporates three market imperfections: an intergenerational externality, a constraint on saving for future consumption, and incomplete insurance markets. It also considers three policy instruments: subsidies for health investment, subsidies for health expenditures, and a pay‐as‐you‐go pension replacement rate. We analyze how the imperfections, along with evolving trends in mortality and morbidity, shape the optimal set‐up of social security policies. Our findings show that there is no universal design for optimal social security: the effectiveness of each instrument depends on the others and on market conditions, with stronger prevention policies emerging as key in aging societies and in systems with less generous pensions.
abstract_zh: 公共养老金与公共医疗政策——统称为社会保障政策——成本高昂，且日益受到人口结构变化的挑战。本文采用一个两期世代交叠模型（其中健康投资同时影响死亡率和发病率），从理论层面分析社会保障的最优设计。模型纳入三种市场不完善因素：代际外部性、未来消费储蓄约束以及不完全保险市场；同时考虑三种政策工具：健康投资补贴、医疗支出补贴以及现收现付制养老金替代率。我们分析了这些市场不完善因素如何与死亡率和发病率的演变趋势共同塑造社会保障政策的最优配置。研究结果表明，最优社会保障并不存在统一模式：每种工具的有效性取决于其他工具及市场条件，在老龄化社会及养老金待遇较低的制度中，强化预防性政策成为关键举措。

title: Approximating competitive equilibrium by Nash welfare
title_zh: 用纳什福利近似竞争均衡
title_primary: 用纳什福利近似竞争均衡
title_secondary: Approximating competitive equilibrium by Nash welfare
authors: Jugal Garg, Yixin Tao, László A. Végh
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We study the relationship between two central concepts in the allocation of divisible goods: competitive equilibrium (CE) and allocations that maximize Nash welfare, i.e., allocations where the weighted geometric mean of the utilities is maximal. When agents have homogeneous concave utility functions, these concepts coincide: the classical Eisenberg–Gale convex program that maximizes Nash welfare over feasible allocations yields a competitive equilibrium. However, they diverge for non–homogeneous utilities. From a computational perspective, maximizing Nash welfare amounts to solving a convex program for any concave utility functions, whereas computing CE becomes PPAD-hard already for separable piecewise linear concave (SPLC) utilities. We introduce the concept of Gale-substitute utility functions, an analogue of the weak gross substitutes (WGS) property for the so-called Gale demand system. For Gale-substitutes utilities, we show that any allocation maximizing Nash welfare provides an approximate-CE with surprisingly strong guarantees, where every agent gets at least half the maximum utility they can get at any CE, and is approximately envy-free. Gale-substitutes include utility functions where computing CE is PPAD hard, such as all separable concave utilities and the previously studied non-separable class of Leontief-free utilities. We introduce a broad new class of utility functions called generalized network utilities based on the generalized flow model. This class includes SPLC and Leontief-free utilities, and we show that all such utilities are Gale-substitutes. Conversely, although some agents may get much higher utility at a Nash welfare maximizing allocation than at a CE, we show a ‘price of anarchy’ type result: for general concave utilities, every CE achieves at least (1/e)1/e > 0.69 fraction of the maximum Nash welfare, and this factor is tight.
abstract_zh: 我们探讨了可分割商品分配中的两个核心概念之间的关系：竞争均衡（CE）与最大化纳什福利的分配，即加权几何平均效用最大的分配。当代理具有齐次凹效用函数时，这两个概念是一致的：经典的Eisenberg-Gale凸规划在可行分配上最大化纳什福利，从而产生竞争均衡。然而，对于非齐次效用，它们则出现分歧。从计算角度看，对于任何凹效用函数，最大化纳什福利等同于求解一个凸规划，而计算CE对于可分分段线性凹（SPLC）效用已经是PPAD难问题。我们引入了Gale替代效用函数的概念，这是弱总替代（WGS）性质在所谓的Gale需求系统中的类比。对于Gale替代效用，我们证明任何最大化纳什福利的分配都能提供一个具有惊人强保证的近似CE，其中每个代理至少获得其在任何CE中能获得的最大效用的一半，并且近似无嫉妒。Gale替代效用包括计算CE为PPAD难问题的效用函数，如所有可分凹效用以及先前研究的非可分Leontief-free效用类别。我们基于广义流模型引入了一类广泛的新效用函数，称为广义网络效用。这一类别包括SPLC和Leontief-free效用，并且我们证明所有这些效用都是Gale替代的。相反，尽管某些代理在纳什福利最大化分配中可能获得比在CE中高得多的效用，我们展示了一个“无政府状态价格”类型的结果：对于一般凹效用，每个CE至少实现最大纳什福利的(1/e)^(1/e) > 0.69比例，且这一因子是紧的。

title: Minimum wage and employer‐sponsored supplementary health insurance: Evidence from Canada
title_zh: 最低工资与雇主资助的补充健康保险：来自加拿大的证据
title_primary: 最低工资与雇主资助的补充健康保险：来自加拿大的证据
title_secondary: Minimum wage and employer‐sponsored supplementary health insurance: Evidence from Canada
authors: Zichun Zhao, Michel Grignon
official: 官方在线 2026-05-18 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This study explores the effect of increases in the minimum wage on the probability of receiving employer‐sponsored supplementary prescription drug insurance through the workplace in Canada: Do Canadian employers respond to higher minimum wage by cutting insurance coverage? We use self‐reports on supplementary health insurance through the workplace from seven waves (2013 to 2019) of the Canadian Community Health Survey. We also use the fact that the minimum wage is a provincial jurisdiction in Canada to study the effects of the level of and changes in the minimum wage across provinces and over time in a difference‐in‐differences and triple difference framework. We find that yearly changes between 20 and 30 cents in the value of the minimum wage have a persistent effect and about three percent of Canadians lose their prescription drug insurance (from an initial coverage rate of 47.4%) in such cases, the effect being concentrated on women, immigrants, non‐Whites and younger adults. However, changes smaller than 20 cents, by far the most frequent in Canada, do not have any discernible effect on health insurance coverage.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了加拿大最低工资上涨对员工通过工作场所获得雇主资助的补充处方药保险概率的影响：加拿大雇主是否会通过削减保险覆盖来应对更高的最低工资？我们利用加拿大社区健康调查七个波次（2013年至2019年）中关于工作场所补充健康保险的自我报告数据。同时，鉴于最低工资在加拿大属于省级管辖范围，我们利用这一事实，在双重差分和三重差分框架下，研究各省份间及时间上最低工资水平及其变动的影响。我们发现，最低工资每年变动20至30加分时，会产生持续性影响，在此情况下，约有3%的加拿大人失去其处方药保险（初始覆盖率为47.4%），且这一影响主要集中在女性、移民、非白人和年轻成年人群体中。然而，低于20加分的变动——这在加拿大最为常见——对健康保险覆盖没有明显影响。

title: How Do Large Epidemics Redistribute Market Power? Evidence from the 2003 SARS Shock in China
title_zh: 大型流行病如何重新分配市场力量？来自2003年中国SARS冲击的证据
title_primary: 大型流行病如何重新分配市场力量？来自2003年中国SARS冲击的证据
title_secondary: How Do Large Epidemics Redistribute Market Power? Evidence from the 2003 SARS Shock in China
authors: Yating Jiang, Hongsong Zhang
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-14 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Market power is costly to build and, once established, is typically persistent and difficult to change. This paper investigates the impact of large economic shocks (serious epidemics) on the redistribution of market power in manufacturing industries. Using a model of firms’ dynamic decisions on production, pricing, and inventory holding, we demonstrate the importance of inventory stock and demand uncertainty in understanding market power and propose a new measure of market power. We find that the 2003 SARS shock in China significantly reduced the market power of firms in SARS-impacted areas. This effect is long lasting. SARS also substantially increased the inventory of affected firms, which partially contributed to the redistribution of market power.
abstract_zh: 市场势力的构建成本高昂，且一旦形成便具有显著的持久性和难以改变的特征。本文探究了重大经济冲击（严重流行病）对制造业市场势力再分配的影响。通过构建企业生产、定价与库存持有动态决策模型，我们论证了库存规模与需求不确定性在理解市场势力中的关键作用，并提出了一种新的市场势力测度方法。研究发现，2003年中国非典疫情冲击显著降低了疫区企业的市场势力，且该效应具有长期持续性。非典疫情还大幅增加了受影响企业的库存水平，这在一定程度上推动了市场势力的再分配。

title: An economic approach to mitigating spillover bias in synthetic control methods: An application to the price effects of fishing quotas
title_zh: 减轻合成控制法中溢出偏差的经济学方法：以捕捞配额价格效应为例
title_primary: 减轻合成控制法中溢出偏差的经济学方法：以捕捞配额价格效应为例
title_secondary: An economic approach to mitigating spillover bias in synthetic control methods: An application to the price effects of fishing quotas
authors: Jordan Moor, Andrew Ropicki, Frank Asche, Adams Ceballos‐Concha
official: 官方在线 2026-05-12 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Individual Fishing Quotas (IFQs) have the potential to lead to higher ex‐vessel prices by reducing market gluts and improving product quality. While IFQs have been introduced in a number of fisheries in recent decades, few causal studies investigate their price effects. Using synthetic control methods on US reef‐fish fisheries, we show that IFQs significantly increase prices for red snapper, red grouper, gag grouper, yellowedge grouper, scamp grouper, and tilefish. We also find significant positive price spillovers to adjacent, untreated fisheries. A primary challenge to unbiased estimation using synthetic control is treatment spillover, which can contaminate both never‐treated units in the donor pool and to‐be‐treated units in a staggered implementation. When control (donor) units are subject to these spillovers, this can lead to either attenuation or divergence of the causal estimate, depending on the empirical setting. To address this estimation challenge, we propose a framework relying on economic theory (market arbitrage and product substitution) and empirical analysis (e.g., market integration or demand estimation) to inform both donor selection and the timing of the treatment start date. As a result, our proposed structure improves the accuracy of synthetic control estimates, as shown by a small Monte Carlo experiment. Furthermore, by pre‐identifying contaminated units, our framework allows for the direct measurement of the spillover effects themselves.
abstract_zh: 个人捕捞配额（IFQs）可能通过减少市场过剩和改善产品质量来提高离岸价格。尽管近几十年来多个渔业已引入IFQs，但关于其价格效应的因果研究仍较为匮乏。通过在美国礁石鱼类渔业中应用合成控制方法，我们发现IFQs显著提高了红鲷鱼、红石斑鱼、黑斑石斑鱼、黄边石斑鱼、斑纹石斑鱼和方头鱼的价格。同时，我们还发现IFQs对邻近未受政策影响的渔业产生了显著的正向价格溢出效应。使用合成控制方法进行无偏估计的主要挑战在于处理溢出效应——这种效应可能污染供体池中从未受处理的单元，以及在分阶段实施中即将受处理的单元。当控制（供体）单元受到这些溢出效应影响时，因果估计可能产生衰减或发散，具体取决于实证环境。为应对这一估计挑战，我们提出一个基于经济理论（市场套利与产品替代）和实证分析（如市场整合或需求估计）的框架，以指导供体选择和处理起始时间的确定。通过小型蒙特卡洛实验验证，我们提出的结构显著提升了合成控制估计的准确性。此外，通过预先识别受污染的单元，该框架还能直接测量溢出效应本身。

title: 政府产业基金支持企业创新的最优投资模式研究
title_zh: 政府产业基金支持企业创新的最优投资模式研究

title: The IJIO special issue on market power and the economy: An introduction
title_zh: 市场力量与经济：IJIO特刊导论
title_primary: 市场力量与经济：IJIO特刊导论
title_secondary: The IJIO special issue on market power and the economy: An introduction
authors: Alon Eizenberg
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-04-07 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Considerable interest has emerged over the past decade in the relationship between macroeconomic outcomes and industry-level market power. The Special Issue on Market Power and the Economy contains seven original contributions offering theoretical and empirical perspectives on these subtle relationships. A brief introduction offers an overview and discussion of avenues for future research by industrial organization economists.
abstract_zh: 过去十年间，宏观经济结果与行业层面市场力量之间的关系引起了广泛关注。《市场力量与经济》特刊收录了七篇原创研究，从理论与实证角度探讨了这些微妙关系。简短引言概述了这些研究，并讨论了产业组织经济学家未来研究的方向。

title: Persistence in a changing world: Gold backing and monetary policy autonomy under Bretton Woods
title_zh: 变化世界中的持续性：布雷顿森林体系下的黄金支撑与货币政策自主性
title_primary: 变化世界中的持续性：布雷顿森林体系下的黄金支撑与货币政策自主性
title_secondary: Persistence in a changing world: Gold backing and monetary policy autonomy under Bretton Woods
authors: Eric Monnet
official: 官方在线 2026-03-26 · 来源：RSS
abstract: The Bretton Woods system is often described as freeing national monetary policies from the gold‐reserve constraints of the gold standard. Breaking the ‘gold fetters’ was essential to the embedded liberalism and economic interventionism of the post‐war era. Yet gold retained a crucial role: monetary authorities backed currency with gold reserves, both de facto and de jure, frequently maintaining gold cover ratios comparable to those of the gold standard. How, then, could gold backing coexist with autonomous domestic macroeconomic policy? This article shows that the combination of two phenomena provides an answer: credit growth and currency growth became increasingly decoupled after 1945, and central banks shifted their emphasis from money toward credit. This created substantial scope to stimulate domestic economic activity through credit expansion without being constrained by the link between gold and currency in circulation. Econometric analysis for 38 countries indicates that gold reserves remained strongly correlated with currency, but not with bank credit. Changes in credit markets and central bank instruments therefore allowed gold backing to persist largely as a symbolic tie, without constraining domestic policy. Gold, however, exerted pressure on US policy and shaped international monetary relations. These findings show that institutional persistence does not guarantee similar economic effects.
abstract_zh: 布雷顿森林体系常被描述为将国家货币政策从金本位的黄金储备约束中解放出来。打破“黄金枷锁”对于战后时代的嵌入式自由主义和经济干预主义至关重要。然而，黄金仍扮演着关键角色：货币当局以黄金储备为货币背书，无论事实上还是法律上，其黄金覆盖率往往与金本位时期相当。那么，黄金背书如何能与自主的国内宏观经济政策共存？本文表明，两种现象的结合提供了答案：1945年后，信贷增长与货币增长日益脱钩，且中央银行将重心从货币转向信贷。这为通过信贷扩张刺激国内经济活动创造了巨大空间，而不受黄金与流通货币之间联系的制约。对38个国家的计量经济学分析表明，黄金储备与货币仍高度相关，但与银行信贷无关。因此，信贷市场的变化及中央银行工具的调整，使得黄金背书在很大程度上作为一种象征性纽带得以延续，而未对国内政策形成约束。然而，黄金确实对美国政策施加了压力，并塑造了国际货币关系。这些发现表明，制度的持续性并不保证产生相似的经济效应。

title: How to Increase Public Support for Carbon Pricing with Revenue Recycling
title_zh: 如何通过收入循环提高公众对碳定价的支持
title_primary: 如何通过收入循环提高公众对碳定价的支持
title_secondary: How to Increase Public Support for Carbon Pricing with Revenue Recycling
authors: Andrej Woerner, Taisuke Imai, Davide Pace, Klaus Schmidt
official: 官方在线 2024-10-16 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Carbon pricing is a powerful but politically contentious tool for tackling climate change. Governments can, however, try to increase public support for it by adjusting how the revenues raised by the carbon price are used. In a fully incentivised experiment with a large representative sample of the German population, we compare voter support for five different carbon pricing schemes. We show that uniform carbon dividends (equal per capita transfers to all citizens) receive substantially more support than a carbon dividend that favours poorer people, than earmarking revenues for climate projects, and especially than using revenues for the general government budget. Among the uniform carbon dividend schemes, a Climate Premium that pays a fixed upfront transfer equal to the expected carbon revenues receives more support than a carbon dividend scheme where the size of the transfer is determined ex-post based on the actual revenues. Furthermore, we show that participants and experts underestimate public support for carbon pricing. These findings suggest that policies for sustainable development gain more support when affected voters are uniformly compensated for the costs imposed on them. In addition, the paper highlights the importance of incentivised experiments in studying public support for such policies.
abstract_zh: 碳定价是应对气候变化的有力但政治上具有争议性的工具。然而，政府可以通过调整碳定价所产生收入的用途来尝试提升公众对其的支持。在一项针对德国人口大规模代表性样本的完全激励实验中，我们比较了选民对五种不同碳定价方案的支持度。研究表明，统一碳红利（向所有公民按人均等额转移支付）获得的公众支持显著高于偏向贫困群体的碳红利、将收入专项用于气候项目，尤其是将收入纳入政府一般预算的方案。在统一碳红利方案中，预先支付相当于预期碳收入固定金额的"气候溢价"方案，比根据实际收入事后确定转移规模的碳红利方案获得更多支持。此外，我们发现参与者和专家均低估了公众对碳定价的支持度。这些发现表明，当受影响选民因政策成本获得统一补偿时，可持续发展政策能获得更多支持。同时，本文强调了激励实验在研究此类政策公众支持度中的重要性。

title: The Impact of Monetary Policy and Lender-of-Last-Resort Announcements on the Treasury Market
title_zh: 货币政策与最后贷款人公告对国债市场的影响
title_primary: 货币政策与最后贷款人公告对国债市场的影响
title_secondary: The Impact of Monetary Policy and Lender-of-Last-Resort Announcements on the Treasury Market
authors: Lena Boneva, Jonas Jensen, Steffi Weidner
official: 官方在线 2023-09-05 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper presents new empirical evidence on the behavior of the U.S Treasury market in response to Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) announcements during the Global Financial Crisis and the Covid-19 pandemic. We differentiate between announcements related to policy rate changes and those related to lender-of-last-resort liquidity facilities to examine their distinct impacts on the market. High-frequency data on interest rate futures are used to extract the surprise component of FOMC announcements. To also make use of announcements taking place outside the future exchanges trading hours, we show that high-frequency changes in exchange rates can be used to impute commonly used monetary policy surprises. Our findings reveal that policy rate and liquidity announcements decrease Treasury yields substantially but differ in their transmission mechanism. While announcements related to interest rates primarily affect bond yields through expected lower short rates, lender-of-last-resort announcements decrease bond yields by reducing term premia, demonstrating the complementary role of these different policies in stabilizing the Treasury market by influencing intermediaries and interest rates.
abstract_zh: 本文提供了关于全球金融危机和新冠疫情期间美国国债市场对联邦公开市场委员会（FOMC）公告反应的新实证证据。我们区分了与政策利率变动相关的公告和与最后贷款人流动性便利相关的公告，以考察它们对市场的不同影响。利用利率期货的高频数据提取FOMC公告中的意外成分。为充分利用期货交易所交易时间之外的公告，我们证明汇率的高频变化可用于推算常用的货币政策意外。研究结果表明，政策利率和流动性公告显著降低了国债收益率，但其传导机制存在差异。与利率相关的公告主要通过预期短期利率下降影响债券收益率，而最后贷款人公告则通过降低期限溢价来减少债券收益率，这揭示了这些不同政策在通过影响中介机构和利率来稳定国债市场方面的互补作用。
